key_insight: HealthAgentBench is a new 54-task benchmark that tests whether AI agents can handle realistic, end-to-end healthcare workflows across diverse environments, and current frontier agents still struggle overall.
clinical_relevance: The benchmark helps identify where healthcare AI agents may be useful or unreliable in complex clinical and research workflows before real-world deployment.
method: Built 54 agentic healthcare tasks across 7 categories, each with its own environment.
Designed tasks to mimic end-to-end clinical workflows using minimal instructions, raw healthcare data, and multi-step actions.
Evaluated frontier agents with a single final task success rate for overall performance.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that overall success was low, with the strongest and most cost-effective agent, Codex GPT-5.5, reaching only about 42% success rate.
watch_item: Benchmark performance may not directly translate to bedside clinical safety or real-world usefulness, since tasks are simulated and depend on the specific environment design.
paper_title: HealthAgentBench: A Unified Benchmark Suite of Realistic Agentic Healthcare Environments for Challenging Frontier AI Agents
